descriptionByLocale.en:
• Medical Secretary: in radiology with dispositional experience 80% - 100%, as of 01.08.2026 or by agreement Apply now The Limmattal Hospital thrives on interdisciplinary cooperation. The team members of the medical administration support the medical profession in all administrative matters and work closely together with the care and all other areas. The entire medical administration is under an overall leadership, which further strengthens and simplifies interdisciplinary cooperation. It awaits you a versatile demanding work in a well-structured secretariat with a dynamic team In addition, you are exactly right in the LIMMI if a family atmosphere and a modern workplace are important to you. Here they engage
• when accepting investigation applications by telephone
• in the disposition of electronic assignments
• When planning interventional radiology
• in the provision of patient records
• in contact with patients and referring internal and external referrals
• when processing and completing general secretarial work
• bring a completed vocational training in the medical / or commercial area with the further training as medical secretary
• are an organisational talent with solid medical terminology and excellent knowledge of German
• love daily patient contact and enjoy working in a lively environment
• Appreciate in a collegial, helpful team
• are a winning personality who does not lose empathy, friendliness and overview even in stressful situations
• Reduced employee parking spaces
• Motorcycle parking, lockable bicycle parking
• With the ZVV Bonus Pass / Z-Bonus Pass we offer an attractive public transport subscription for employees
